```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)

  library(naniar)
})
```

```{r}
#! label: "get-data"
treatment_data <- read.csv("data/Clinical_Treatment_Data.csv")
```

```{r}
all_meta_columns <- colnames(treatment_data)
drug_columns <- all_meta_columns[grepl("^Drug",all_meta_columns)]
```

```{r}
#| label: subtype-annotation
treatment_data$cancer_subtype <- case_when(((treatment_data$er_status_by_ihc == "Positive") | (treatment_data$pr_status_by_ihc == "Positive")) & (treatment_data$her2_status_by_ihc == "Positive") ~ "HR+/HER2+",
                                        ((treatment_data$er_status_by_ihc == "Positive") | (treatment_data$pr_status_by_ihc == "Positive")) & (treatment_data$her2_status_by_ihc == "Negative") ~ "HR+/HER2-",
                                        treatment_data$her2_status_by_ihc == "Positive" ~ "HER2+(HR-)",
                                        (treatment_data$er_status_by_ihc == "Negative") & (treatment_data$pr_status_by_ihc == "Negative") & (treatment_data$her2_status_by_ihc == "Negative") ~ "TNBC",
                                        .default = "Unknown")
```

## Cancer subtype statistics

```{r}
table(treatment_data$er_status_by_ihc)
```

```{r}
table(treatment_data$er_status_by_ihc, treatment_data$pr_status_by_ihc)
```

```{r}
table(treatment_data$cancer_subtype)
```

```{r}
hr_her2_treatment_data <- treatment_data %>% filter(cancer_subtype %in% c("HR+/HER2-", "HR+/HER2+"))
write.table(hr_her2_treatment_data, "data/hr_her2_cancer_subset.tsv", sep="\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

## Features QC

### Missing values per column
```{r}
hr_her2_treatment_data <- hr_her2_treatment_data %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.character), str_trim))
hr_her2_treatment_data[hr_her2_treatment_data == ""] <- NA
```

```{r}
missing_values <- colSums(is.na(hr_her2_treatment_data))
missing_props <- round(missing_values/nrow(hr_her2_treatment_data)*100,2)
columns_with_missing <- names(missing_props[missing_props > 0])
missing_data <- data.frame(values = missing_values, props = missing_props)
missing_data %>% filter(props>0) %>% arrange(desc(props))
```

### Zero variance columns
```{r}
# Count unique values per column (ignoring NAs)
unique_counts <- sapply(hr_her2_treatment_data, function(x) length(unique(na.omit(x))))
# Identify columns with 1 or fewer unique values
zero_variance_cols <- names(unique_counts[unique_counts <= 1])
```

### Quasi-complete columns

```{r}
her2_pos_subset <- hr_her2_treatment_data[hr_her2_treatment_data$cancer_subtype == "HR+/HER2+",
                                          !(names(hr_her2_treatment_data) %in% zero_variance_cols)]
```

```{r}
unique_counts <- sapply(her2_pos_subset, function(x) length(unique(na.omit(x))))
# Identify columns with 1 or fewer unique values
zero_variance_cols_pos <- names(unique_counts[unique_counts <= 1])
zero_variance_cols_pos
```

```{r}
her2_neg_subset <- hr_her2_treatment_data[hr_her2_treatment_data$cancer_subtype == "HR+/HER2-",
                                          !(names(hr_her2_treatment_data) %in% c(zero_variance_cols,zero_variance_cols_pos))]
```

```{r}
unique_counts <- sapply(her2_neg_subset, function(x) length(unique(na.omit(x))))
# Identify columns with 1 or fewer unique values
zero_variance_cols_neg <- names(unique_counts[unique_counts <= 1])
zero_variance_cols_neg
```

### Frequency statistics for remaining drugs
```{r}
selected_drug_dataset <- hr_her2_treatment_data[,drug_columns]
selected_drug_dataset <- selected_drug_dataset[,!(names(selected_drug_dataset) %in% c(zero_variance_cols,zero_variance_cols_pos,zero_variance_cols_neg))]
write.table(selected_drug_dataset, "data/selected_drugs_subset.tsv", sep="\t", quote = F, row.names = F)
```

```{r}
drug_props <- colSums(selected_drug_dataset) / nrow(selected_drug_dataset)*100
names(drug_props) <- colnames(selected_drug_dataset)
sort(drug_props, decreasing = TRUE)
```

```{r, fig.height=12}
missing_data_only <- hr_her2_treatment_data %>%
  select(all_of(columns_with_missing))
  #select(where(~ any(is.na(.))))

gg_miss_upset(missing_data_only, 
              nsets = length(columns_with_missing), 
              text.scale = 1.2)
```

```{r}
remove_columns <- c("retrospective_collection",
                    "last_contact_days_to",
                    "micromet_detection_by_ihc",
                    "lymph_nodes_examined_count",
                    "lymph_nodes_examined_he_count",
                    "her2_ihc_score",
                    "Age_in_Years")
columns_with_missing_keep <- setdiff(columns_with_missing, remove_columns)
```

```{r, fig.height=8}
missing_data_only <- hr_her2_treatment_data %>%
  select(all_of(columns_with_missing_keep))

gg_miss_upset(missing_data_only, 
              nsets = length(columns_with_missing_keep), 
              text.scale = 1.2)
```
